title: Explore, Map, Remember, Decide: A Benchmark for VLM Readiness in Safety-Critical Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2608.08077v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are often deployed as embodied controllers for robotics, yet it remains unclear how well they can explore an environment, maintain an internal map, and ground safety-critical decisions in long-horizon sequential trajectories. In this work, we introduce EMRD, an evaluation framework that decouples spatial reasoning into four stages: Explore (what the agent observes), Map (what it records and where), Remember (what it retains), and Decide (whether its final choice is justified), scored across 18 stage-specific metrics. We use EMRD to evaluate eleven open- and closed-weight VLMs across 16 buildings under nominal conditions and three environmental stresses (darkness, smoke, and motion noise), where an embodied VLM explores unknown rooms, maps observed objects, and selects the safest gathering place. translated_title: 探索、绘图、记忆、决策：评估VLM在安全关键场景中就绪度的基准测试
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）常被部署为机器人的具身控制器，但它们在探索环境、维护内部地图以及基于长时序序列轨迹做出安全关键决策方面的能力如何，目前仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们提出了EMRD——一个将空间推理解耦为四个阶段的评估框架：探索（智能体观察到什么）、绘图（它记录了什么以及在哪里）、记忆（它保留了什么）和决策（其最终选择是否有依据），并针对每个阶段设置了18项评分指标。我们使用EMRD在16栋建筑中、于标称条件以及三种环境压力（黑暗、烟雾和运动噪声）下评估了十一个开放权重与闭源权重的VLM，其中具身VLM需要探索未知房间、绘制观察到的物体地图，并选择最安全的集合地点。开放权重模型在95%的情节中存在未探索的房间，且物体检测率最高仅为51%；闭源权重的模型表……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出EMRD评估框架，将VLM的空间推理能力解耦为探索、绘图、记忆、决策四个阶段并以18项指标评分，揭示了现有模型在安全关键场景下存在严重的探索遗漏与感知缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EMRD, an evaluation framework that decomposes VLM spatial reasoning into four stages—Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide—scored by 18 metrics, revealing severe exploration gaps and perception deficiencies of current models in safety-critical scenarios.
